_note: Dr. Yae at the farmer's bed in the clinic, the noon after a collapse (data/events/clinic_wake.json; wake_free the first time, when she lets the fee go, wake_fee after that). Our own lines.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Ah, you're awake. Someone found you face down and ran the whole way here for me.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Nothing broken. Your body simply stopped. That's what it does when you won't.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: No charge this time. Next time I'll bill you, so let there be no next time.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Back in my spare bed again. I'm starting to think it's your favorite.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: The fee's taken care of. Go to bed early tonight, and eat before you work, not after.
